Package frc.spectrumLib.params

package frc.spectrumLib.params
  • Class
    Description
    BooleanParam
    A switch.
    DoubleParam
    A finite number, with inclusive bounds.
    HardwareStamp
    Ties the pit-saved file of a hard-stop group (swerve offsets, soft limits) to the robot it was saved on, so a controller moved to another robot does not bring that robot's values with it.
    IntParam
    A whole number, with inclusive bounds.
    NetworkTablesTransport
    Publishes params at <prefix>/<group>/<key> on NetworkTables through AdvantageKit's LoggedNetwork inputs, so the dashboard's requests are in the log too.
    Param<T>
    One tunable value, declared in code with a name, type, default, units and optional bounds, and resolved from the layers described in Params.
    Param.Type
    The value types a params file and the transport can carry.
    ParamGroup
    Declares the params of one group.
    Params
    Robot params: values tuned on the robot that survive the next deploy, without editing code.
    ParamSource
    Where a param's current value came from.
    ParamTransport
    How params reach a dashboard for live tuning.
    ParamTransport.LiveValue
    A published value: what the dashboard last set, and a way to show a value there.
    StringParam
    Text, such as a camera name or a mode.
    TuningMode
    Whether dashboards may change tunable values.
